summary.text: Brian Lambert is the Libertarian Party nominee for Florida's 14th Congressional District; the Libertarian primary was canceled. He is a retired U.S. Navy veteran who served 20 years and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Cairo High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ashford University in 2018.
Served in the U.S. Navy from 1998 to 2018; in his survey he says he served as an Aircraft Mechanic, a Flight Engineer, and an Intelligence Specialist.
